messages:
zara: Quick Q  I'm converting from US contractor -> UK employee with UK payroll start 2026-10-04. I have 9 unused US floaters and 3 accrued contractor stipend days. What's the rule for mapping to UK bank holidays and carryover caps? Also probation period is 3 months  does that affect accrual or the year-end carryover?
mike-peopleops: Congrats, Zara! Short: UK bank holidays are applied based on your payroll location from your first UK pay date (2026-10-04). We offer a one-time conversion mapping: up to 6 US floaters -> 3 UK flex days (manager + People Ops approval). Contractor stipends are handled separately: payout or one-time convert up to 2 stipend days -> 1 UK flex day (rare). Probation: accrual starts on your first day as FT but some benefits (carryover cap eligibility) require you to be on payroll by Dec 15 to get the full carryover cap.
sophie-payroll: Payroll notes: to avoid retro manual edits we need your signed offer + UK tax docs processed by payroll cutoff 2026-09-20 for the Oct 4 run. Conversion processing: if approved before cutoff we book the conversion as an HR accrual change effective 2026-10-04. If after cutoff we run payroll_adjust --convert --emp=EZARA --from=US_floaters --to=UK_flex --days=6 --eff=2026-10-04 (manual job).
zara: If I convert 6 floaters -> 3 UK flex days, what happens to the remaining 3 floaters? Can they be paid out?
mike-peopleops: Remaining floaters can be requested for payout (taxable) or kept in the US balance if you remain on US payroll for overlapping pay periods (unlikely). Payout must be requested with the conversion form; payroll executes payout on next pay run if approved.
alex-manager: Manager note  operationally we need Zara active on UK hours by 2026-10-11 for the sprint. Zara, can you confirm any planned time off around Oct 10-18 so we can cover? Also if conversion requires manager sign-off I'll approve asap.
zara: No planned time off in that window. One nuance: I have a pending medical appointment on 2026-12-20 that might require sick leave if moved. Does UK statutory sick pay interact with accrued US sick days?
mike-peopleops: Good question. Sick accrual follows the contract in effect that day. If you're on UK payroll on 2026-12-20 then UK statutory sick rules apply, and US accrued sick days don't auto-convert. We do occasionally allow limited conversion for documented medical reasons (manager + HR + medical documentation). If you need to convert specific days, submit the medical conversion form and include the note.
sophie-payroll: Also FYI carryover cap: if you're on UK payroll by Dec 15 and meet the tenure rule, standard carryover cap applies (see policy). If not on payroll by Dec 15, you may lose carryover or need an exception filed by 2026-12-05.
hr-bot: Reminder: conversion/relocation forms required to process accrual changes. Deadline for Oct payroll: 2026-09-20.
zara: I'll submit the relocation and conversion form today and attach emp ID EZARA. mike, tagging you on the conversion mapping request. Thanks everyone for the clarity!
